result.question: What happened to the seven sons of Sceva?

readings.answer: They were attacked and overpowered, and fled naked and wounded.
readings.support: jumped on them and overpowered them all | they ran out of the house naked and wounded.

assessments.reason: It accurately paraphrases that the possessed man jumped on and overpowered them and that they ran out naked and wounded; specifying the agent isn’t required to answer what happened to them.

result.reason: The blind reading matches the passage’s account that they were overpowered and fled the house naked and wounded.
